description: Screens a customer against a sanctions and PEP watchlist by name, aliases and date of birth; thresholds are invented for illustration

rules.description: A missing or blank name cannot be screened; without this rule it would score 0 and pass as CLEAR
A name or alias of the customer scores 0.92 or more against a name or alias of a sanctions entry with the same date of birth
rules.when: has(customer.dateOfBirth) && watchlist.exists(w, w.listType == 'SANCTIONS' && has(w.dateOfBirth) && w.dateOfBirth == customer.dateOfBirth && ([customer.fullName] + customer.aliases).exists(n, normalizeName(n) != '' && maxNameSimilarity(n, [w.name] + w.aliases) >= decimal('0.92')))

rules.description: Name or alias scores 0.92 or more against a sanctions entry, but a date of birth is missing or differs
rules.when: watchlist.exists(w, w.listType == 'SANCTIONS' && ([customer.fullName] + customer.aliases).exists(n, normalizeName(n) != '' && maxNameSimilarity(n, [w.name] + w.aliases) >= decimal('0.92')))

rules.description: Name or alias scores from 0.85 to below 0.92 against a sanctions entry; scores of 0.92 or more were caught above
rules.when: watchlist.exists(w, w.listType == 'SANCTIONS' && ([customer.fullName] + customer.aliases).exists(n, normalizeName(n) != '' && maxNameSimilarity(n, [w.name] + w.aliases) >= decimal('0.85')))

rules.description: Name or alias scores 0.92 or more against a politically exposed person; checked after sanctions, which take priority
rules.when: watchlist.exists(w, w.listType == 'PEP' && ([customer.fullName] + customer.aliases).exists(n, normalizeName(n) != '' && maxNameSimilarity(n, [w.name] + w.aliases) >= decimal('0.92')))

rules.description: No alert from these rules; not a clearance
